compile.connector_rule: Insert one geometry-only midpoint only when adjacent authored keys have identical support_contact and contact_state. If either changes, hard-cut. Midpoints interpolate existing joint coordinates only and cannot introduce support/contact/root-phase/force/facing state.
compile.method: AUTHORED ASCII KEYS -> EXPLICIT HOLDS/TIMING -> DETERMINISTIC CONNECTIVE MOTION -> ASCII-ONLY FRAME RENDER -> MP4 -> SPA
compile.renderer: Python/Pillow renders literal ASCII frames; ffmpeg libx264 yuv420p

INFERRED: Generic vertical-force grammar: LOAD -> LAUNCH -> RISE -> APEX_READ -> AIR_TASK_ORIENT -> FALL -> PRECONTACT_OPEN -> CONTACT -> LAND_COMPRESSION -> REBOUND -> RETURN_STABLE.
A dedicated PRECONTACT_OPEN key can make landing intention readable before support is acquired; support stays NONE until CONTACT.
CONTACT and LAND_COMPRESSION are separate causal keys so ground reacquisition does not collapse into force absorption.
Aerial task changes and limb counterbalance ride the already-authored root arc; they do not create an additional vertical impulse.
All timing classes use the PoseLab V1 STREET_FIGHTER/CAPCOM inference vocabulary because source timing is unavailable.
OBSERVED: The complete sheet visibly separates named Jumping, Falling, and Landing pose families.

The same whole sheet also contains multiple explicitly named airborne task/attack families, including Sonic Rocket (Air attack), Sonic Eagle (Air attack), Sonic Meteor (Air power), and Sonic Air Cracker (Air trap).
Across the upper airborne body families, the lead/facing direction remains broadly readable while limb organization changes.
The complete sheet also contains grounded guard/heal/attack anchors plus knocked-up, knocked-back, wall/ground-hit, getting-up, blocked, and wall-cling consequence/recovery families.
TSR reports Animations (0); the static sheet does not establish source-authentic decisive-key exposure durations.

keys.motion_arc_root_note: Root lowers over a stable two-foot base; facing remains right.
keys.name: LOAD

keys.causal_role: support break and initial upward impulse
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Root leaves the grounded load and begins upward travel; no connective frame may invent residual support.
keys.name: LAUNCH

keys.causal_role: upward root travel with limb counterbalance
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Root rises; rear arm and split legs counterbalance while facing stays right.
keys.name: RISE

keys.causal_role: hang-time readability at vertical velocity sign change
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Root reaches the top of the authored arc; silhouette opens to make the sign change readable without adding support.
keys.name: APEX_READ

keys.causal_role: aerial task/pose change while the root begins descending
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Root has crossed apex and descends; local upper-body task changes while facing remains right.
keys.name: AIR_TASK_ORIENT

keys.causal_role: clear downward travel after task change
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Root continues downward; limbs leave the task silhouette and begin reorganizing for landing.
keys.name: FALL

keys.causal_role: landing window: organize limbs before support exists
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Feet target the ground while support/contact remain NONE; arms counterbalance the opening base.
keys.name: PRECONTACT_OPEN

keys.motion_arc_root_note: Both feet acquire ground here; contact is the event and compression has not yet reached its deepest point.
keys.name: CONTACT

keys.motion_arc_root_note: Root continues down after contact into a deeper grounded compression; support is already owned.
keys.name: LAND_COMPRESSION

keys.causal_role: small grounded recovery from landing compression
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Root rises slightly while support remains grounded; this is rebound, not a second airborne launch.
keys.name: REBOUND

keys.causal_role: return to stable action-capable grounded state
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Root restacks over the base; rightward facing and neutral limb availability are restored.
keys.name: RETURN_STABLE
